verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents an API reference at tryjeeves.redocly.app/apis, with endpoints and authentication described. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as try-it consoles or executable snippets. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, and any interactive features of the Redocly hosting platform would be host-platform capabilities that cannot be credited without evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
